# Third-party dependencies

The dependencies in this directory are vendored so configuring and building
the project does not require downloading them at build time.

## SDL2

- Version: 2.30.10
- Upstream: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/tree/release-2.30.10
- License: zlib license; see `SDL2/LICENSE.txt`

- Upstream: https://github.com/nothings/stb
- Upstream commit: `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`
- Vendored file: `stb/stb_image.h`
- SHA-256: `1F8C1B6B408F26E3B20CBFBBD4758AFB3DC9B837FF1E17C258928F406148A87C`
- License: public domain or MIT; see the end of `stb/stb_image.h`
